svg.title: scs-mod-forge architecture: Claude in Chrome researches real references and writes the prompt, Claude Code builds in Blender through MCP, ETS2 verifies
svg.text: Research in the browser → build in Blender → verify in the game
claude.ai + the Chrome extension: browses, views images, searches
in your mod project folder, connected to a running Blender
ranks the likely causes (normals, culling, IDs…)
image search, OEM / review galleries, forums
pulls the direct image URLs from result pages
rejects aftermarket parts, wrong market or generation
SCS Wiki: what Prism3D can actually do
per defect: now · real · diagnose · build · accept
curl the reference URLs into refs/, opens them
packed into the mod folder or .scs
F12 screenshots → Claude Code compares and iterates
You → Claude: new screenshots + “what still looks wrong” = next round
Inner loop (green): runs many times inside one round until the in-game view matches the photo. Outer loop (teal): one turn per round.
